wood.name: Wood
wood.description: Freshly gathered timber for tools, weapons, and building.

stone.name: Stone
stone.description: Rough stone gathered from broken rock nodes.

iron-ore.name: Iron Ore
iron-ore.description: Dense iron-bearing ore ready to be refined into metal.

charcoal.name: Charcoal
charcoal.description: A lightweight fuel used for smelting and advanced crafting.

purple-berry-mat.name: Purple Berry
purple-berry-mat.description: A sweet foraged berry. Used in brewing.

stone-essence.name: Stone Essence
stone-essence.description: Swallow it for the Stone form: heavy, no knockback, holds plates down.

silk-essence.name: Silk Essence
silk-essence.description: Swallow it for the Silk form: spider webs let you through.

swim-essence.name: Swim Essence
swim-essence.description: Swallow it for the Swim form: deep water lets you in.

weaver-fang.name: Weaver Fang
weaver-fang.description: A hooked fang from a Gloop Forest orb-weaver, hard enough to bite into iron.

iron-bar.name: Iron Bar
iron-bar.description: Smelted iron from the Forge, ready to be shaped into gear at the workbench.

shard.name: Crystal Shard
shard.description: A glittering crystal. Could power something.

green-key.name: Verdant Key
green-key.description: A leaf-shaped green key carried by Fatty One Eye's guarded chest.

crystal-key.name: Crystal Key
crystal-key.description: A key of living crystal. It opens the sealed way into the Crystal Caverns (Chapter 3).

workbench.name: Workbench
workbench.description: A sturdy bench for shaping wood and stone into tools and weapons. Place it anywhere, then use it to craft.

berry-basket.name: Berry Basket
berry-basket.description: A woven basket of sweet berries. Restores 20 HP and 30 energy.

matron-thread.name: Matron's Thread
matron-thread.description: A spool of the Orb-Weaver Matron's own silk, strong as wire: a bowstring fit for the Thorn Guard. Pip, the smith's son, could string a bow rune with it.

mine-crystal.name: Smith's Crystal
mine-crystal.description: The clearest crystal the smith's mine ever gave him, saved for something special. Pip can carve it into the heart of a bow rune.

belt-slot.name: Belt Slot
belt-slot.description: A sturdy loop for the slime's belt. It holds one kind of potion, ready on a number key.

charged-roll.name: Charged Roll
charged-roll.description: An old Thorn Guard trick for the Roll: curl up tight and spin before you go, and shoot off fast and far.

roll-fragment.name: Roll Fragment
roll-fragment.description: A quarter of Burr's old Thorn Guard training disc, carved with the Charged Roll's spin. Four of them teach the whole trick.

war-journal-page-1.name: War Journal, Page 1
war-journal-page-1.description: A page of the Thorn Guard's war journal: the old gates.

page.title: The Old Gates
lines: Third night at the old gates. The worms came up out of the ground at dusk, more than we could count.
Gorge has made an army of them: swordsmen, archers, brawlers, every one in his red scarf.
We held. The moss on the gateposts is trampled flat, but not one of them got past.
Yoi says a gate is only as strong as the slimes behind it. Tonight, that was strong enough.

war-journal-page-2.name: War Journal, Page 2
war-journal-page-2.description: A page of the Thorn Guard's war journal: the forts.

page.title: The Forts
lines: The forts are lost. One by one, the watch-fires went out on the hills.
Gorge's vassals each carry a Pearl now, a piece of the Wellspring's own heart.
A Pearl's power used without wisdom does dark things. They woke our fallen and set them to guard the very forts where they fell.
If you meet them, little one, remember they were brave once. Their helmets still say so.

war-journal-page-3.name: War Journal, Page 3
war-journal-page-3.description: A page of the Thorn Guard's war journal: the last watch.

page.title: The Last Watch
lines: The Wellspring grows dimmer every night. No new slime has bubbled up since spring.
The elders have taken everyone below. Slimeshire hides under its own floor now, in the hideouts we dug.
Someone has to stay up top and keep watch. Yoi says it will be him, and nobody could talk him out of it.
Whoever finds this: the Pearls can come home. Bring them back to the Wellspring, and it will shine again.

recipe-page-berry-basket.name: Recipe Page: Berry Basket
recipe-page-berry-basket.description: A Thorn Guard field recipe, for the long watches.

page.title: Berry Basket
lines: A Thorn Guard field recipe, for the long watches.
Two handfuls of purple berries in a little basket woven from five sticks, warmed by a campfire.
One on watch keeps a slime bright-eyed till dawn.
